name: auaha
description: Creative industries pack — agencies, studios, designers, photographers, film/TV, music, publishing, and freelance creatives. Drafts campaign briefs, creative contracts and IP-assignment terms, and content production plans against the Copyright Act 1994, the Fair Trading Act 1986 (s.9 misleading-conduct test), the ASA codes, and standard NZ contractor terms. Every output is staged for the agency producer, the operator's solicitor, or the senior creative to review and sign.
